optimizer_randomness_interpretation: part of the joint stream-level randomisation distribution; treatment-specific addressed namespaces derive from the one stream optimiser base key
decision_rationale: F02 requires delta=0.005 to be scientifically usable for benefit/harm/equivalence classification.
320 is the smallest sample size in the already predeclared historical precision grid that passed the stated screen in all five analytical stress profiles.
F09 deliberately does not introduce a new intermediate sample-size grid after the 80/320 bracket is already known.
One optimiser key per independent stream avoids spending a threefold multiplier on nested pseudo-replication while still integrating optimiser randomness into the independent stream distribution.
